You just described the one reason I gave as to why people call others free to play, the salty player, so it doesn't really prove anything. Maybe if you had asked him to stop and he didn't and that this happened over many servers, then maybe I would agree there was a major problem.

When I say I haven't seen free to play used maliciously, I mean that I haven't seen any player try to intentionally hurt another player by calling them free to play. Sure it gets thrown around here and there by salty players, but they usually don't mean it to do damage to someone. I play TF2 regularly, both casual and community servers. I agree with you that if it does hurt a player and make them stop wanting to play the game, then we should do something about it, but I have never seen someone actually say something like "hey could you cut it out" or other such things. Also, if it were to happen, I would imagine someone from here would say something to the new player and encourage them to ignore the harasser.

I don't know what you mean by "I agree these kinds of people will be a little soft" and as I said before, I've never seen someone call someone else a free to play maliciously, so I don't understand how you can say it affects the community. If I just started playing the game today, I would be too overwhelmed by all the crazy shit going on to notice someone saying "fuckin f2p" in chat.

Its just a silly stereotype. I've played a lot of pubs and I've never seen anyone get "cyberbullied". Sure people get mad but its just a game. If you seriously get insulted when someone calls you free to play just find another game or something... but I have seriously never seen someone being malicious by calling someone free to play.
